name: n019_l9scrsel
purpose: Select a layer-9 from-scratch snapshot on the fixed 40-speaker dev-100 set using UTMOS, WhiSQA, and WER before any full-test or LS360 evaluation.
gate: UTMOS and WhiSQA must improve by at least 0.05 over the selected layer-9 20k adaptation baseline and WER regression must be <= 0.25 pp. The selected candidate must then be compared to the formal layer-6 quality tuple before any full evaluation.
dependency_plan: Submit with afterany on the chosen scratch training job. Do not submit before training produces snapshots.
